substrate.summary: Deterministic installer, bootstrap, and CLI release tests validated latest-to-pinned handoff, pinned install verification, install-root transaction safety, reinstall/update/downgrade policy, and installed status diagnostics without requiring KVM.

command: python3 scripts/test-release-bundle.py && python3 scripts/test-stable-latest-bootstrap.py && cargo test -p m80-cli --test release && python3 scripts/test-release-tracker-policy.py && python3 scripts/verify-release-tracker-policy.py --policy-config docs/behaviors/release/release-tracker-policy.json && git diff --check
stdout: scripts/test-release-bundle.py: 290 tests OK; scripts/test-stable-latest-bootstrap.py: 22 tests OK; cargo test -p m80-cli --test release: 101 tests OK; scripts/test-release-tracker-policy.py: 47 tests OK; verify-release-tracker-policy.py: release tracker policy OK; git diff --check OK
observables: versioned install.sh preflights local tools and root requirements before release downloads
non-root default install with sudo present prints the pinned install.sh retry command before curl
stable latest bootstrap resolves one concrete stable tag and emits only pinned versioned install inputs
pinned install rejects latest artifact URLs, prerelease tags, foreign repositories, raw branch URLs, and path-shaped release assets before install-root mutation

official release installs verify asset index, checksums, installer, bootstrap selector, build manifest, release-integrity predicate, attestation material, bundle metadata, and extracted m80 identity before activation
child install handoff uses the extracted release m80 binary and quarantines ambient M80_* environment overrides
install finalization flips the active pointer last after bundle, proof cache, profile, host manifest, ownership, modes, and smoke/preflight gates
failed verification, interruption, profile/config failure, proof-cache drift, smoke-gate failure, and active-pointer failure leave previous active state selected
same-version reinstall is idempotent for matching verified material and fails closed with exact repair for changed bytes or proof cache
update/downgrade policy refuses older, prerelease, yanked, or unsafe targets unless a separate explicit policy names the allowed action
install-status rechecks active bytes, metadata, profile/config selection, host manifest, proof cache, and repair commands without mutating install-root state
